notes.title: My indie game works:Star-Rocket Strike
notes.content:
In order to develop an extremely original idea, I have spent a mass of energy and time.Without necessary fund and capable assistants,the independent game works was developed slowly.
Just you see,the original game was essentially finished by only one developer,so that is imperfect.
If you like the independent game idea,it's my pleasure to receive your precious suggestion.
Please support my individual game studio,I believe in that I can develop better game works.
